crossRefs.note: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell…
“Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.
that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it…
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of…
Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain…

translations.web: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.
translations.bsb: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert. All its cities were torn down before the LORD, before His fierce anger.
translations.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.
translations.asv: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Jehovah, and before his fierce anger.
